style: Felt applique with editable concept diagrams
provider: Built-in image generation and deterministic SVG diagrams
note: Pictures support interpretation of the editable lesson text; they are not standalone evidence or answer keys. Numerical records and named practice stories are fictional. Read each sort in its stated context. Educator review is pending.

sources.prompt: Use case: scientific-educational. Asset type: square AlloPack lesson illustration. A front-loading washing machine with a swirl of colored fabric clearly visible through its circular glass door. Isolated appliance with generous cream margins, no humans. Hand-cut felt applique with visible stitched edges, simple and tactile. Text-free: no writing, letters, numbers, logos or watermark. Focus on the stated lesson objects; do not add students, decorative badges, explanatory arrows or captions. Keep the subject complete and easy to identify at small size.
sources.alt: A felt-style washing machine has colored fabric swirling behind its round door.
sources.caption: In the invented sentence, Marisol’s stomach is a washing machine on spin cycle. The appliance represents a churning nervous feeling; her stomach is not literally a machine.
